units.rawText: At the Oasis, inside the ruined cafe.

units.rawText: O Assistant, are you sure this will work?
units.displayText: O Assistant, are you sure this will work?

spans.text: O Assistant, are you sure this will work?

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, I'm not too confident.
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, I'm not too confident.

spans.text: Frankly speaking, I'm not too confident.

units.rawText: At this point, all we can do is make a gamble.

units.rawText: Then, in that case... I'll have to release the power sealed in my right hand to fight!

spans.text: Then, in that case... I'll have to release the power sealed in my right hand to fight!

units.rawText: ...Quit talking nonsense and help me out! Okabe, hurry and move those two bags over here!
units.displayText: ...Quit talking nonsense and help me out! Okabe, hurry and move those two bags over here!

spans.text: ...Quit talking nonsense and help me out! Okabe, hurry and move those two bags over here!

units.rawText: Ugh! D-Dammit! Who would have thought the day would come when a mad scientist like me would be ordered around by my own assistant!
units.displayText: Ugh! D-Dammit! Who would have thought the day would come when a mad scientist like me would be ordered around by my own assistant!

spans.text: Ugh! D-Dammit! Who would have thought the day would come when a mad scientist like me would be ordered around by my own assistant!

units.rawText: Despite saying all that, I still obediently move the bags to where I'm told to put them.
units.displayText: Despite saying all that, I still obediently move the bags to where I'm told to put them.

spans.text: Despite saying all that, I still obediently move the bags to where I'm told to put them.

units.rawText: Currently, we're inside the cafe's storeroom. According to Kurisu's calculations, the walls here are solid enough to keep us safe for what's to come.
units.displayText: Currently, we're inside the cafe's storeroom. According to Kurisu's calculations, the walls here are solid enough to keep us safe for what's to come.

spans.text: Currently, we're inside the cafe's storeroom. According to Kurisu's calculations, the walls here are solid enough to keep us safe for what's to come.

units.rawText: The roars of the Entropic seem to approach at times and drift away at others, as though it could appear in front of us at any time.
units.displayText: The roars of the Entropic seem to approach at times and drift away at others, as though it could appear in front of us at any time.

spans.text: The roars of the Entropic seem to approach at times and drift away at others, as though it could appear in front of us at any time.

units.rawText: ...Things being what they are now, all we can do is bear with the purple powder wafting around in this room and wait here to ambush her.
units.displayText: ...Things being what they are now, all we can do is bear with the purple powder wafting around in this room and wait here to ambush her.

spans.text: ...Things being what they are now, all we can do is bear with the purple powder wafting around in this room and wait here to ambush her.

units.rawText: Alright, this is the last thing we need to deploy... Right, how's Mayuri doing?
units.displayText: Alright, this is the last thing we need to deploy... Right, how's Mayuri doing?

spans.text: Alright, this is the last thing we need to deploy... Right, how's Mayuri doing?

units.rawText: I had her hide in another room which hadn't collapsed yet. It's safer there.
units.displayText: I had her hide in another room which hadn't collapsed yet. It's safer there.

spans.text: I had her hide in another room which hadn't collapsed yet. It's safer there.

units.rawText: After all, this is a risky experiment we're working on now... If we can't create a spark and properly trigger the detonation, we'll be the ones buried down here and not the Entropic.
units.displayText: After all, this is a risky experiment we're working on now... If we can't create a spark and properly trigger the detonation, we'll be the ones buried down here and not the Entropic.

spans.text: After all, this is a risky experiment we're working on now... If we can't create a spark and properly trigger the detonation, we'll be the ones buried down here and not the Entropic.

units.rawText: Indeed. Just in case, I've already cut the power supply within the building.
units.displayText: Indeed. Just in case, I've already cut the power supply within the building.

spans.text: Indeed. Just in case, I've already cut the power supply within the building.

units.rawText: So all we have to do now is wait...
units.displayText: So all we have to do now is wait...

spans.text: So all we have to do now is wait...

units.rawText: I glance outside the storeroom. Everything seems normal.
units.displayText: I glance outside the storeroom. Everything seems normal.

spans.text: I glance outside the storeroom. Everything seems normal.

units.rawText: Sweat beads on my palms and my heartbeat pounds in my ears. I feel like I have to say something to break this tension.
units.displayText: Sweat beads on my palms and my heartbeat pounds in my ears. I feel like I have to say something to break this tension.

spans.text: Sweat beads on my palms and my heartbeat pounds in my ears. I feel like I have to say something to break this tension.

units.rawText: ...Say, Assistant, what are you going to do once we get back?
units.displayText: ...Say, Assistant, what are you going to do once we get back?

spans.text: ...Say, Assistant, what are you going to do once we get back?

units.rawText: Please don't go raising death flags at times like these...
units.displayText: Please don't go raising death flags at times like these...

spans.text: Please don't go raising death flags at times like these...

units.rawText: ...I ought to go make sure everyone from the Lab is safe and then ask the Professor to outfit us with combat modules...
units.displayText: ...I ought to go make sure everyone from the Lab is safe and then ask the Professor to outfit us with combat modules...

spans.text: ...I ought to go make sure everyone from the Lab is safe and then ask the Professor to outfit us with combat modules...

units.rawText: Combat modules? Could it be that my comrade has tainted their soul with such forbidden human experimentation?!
units.displayText: Combat modules? Could it be that my comrade has tainted their soul with such forbidden human experimentation?!

spans.text: Combat modules? Could it be that my comrade has tainted their soul with such forbidden human experimentation?!

units.rawText: ...It's a kind of technology that allows us to fight using operands.
units.displayText: ...It's a kind of technology that allows us to fight using operands.

spans.text: ...It's a kind of technology that allows us to fight using operands.

units.rawText: With it, we'll be able to fight these Entropics head on, as opposed to running and hiding like we're doing now.
units.displayText: With it, we'll be able to fight these Entropics head on, as opposed to running and hiding like we're doing now.

spans.text: With it, we'll be able to fight these Entropics head on, as opposed to running and hiding like we're doing now.

units.rawText: I see... That truly is a power that Hououin Kyouma needs.
units.displayText: I see... That truly is a power that Hououin Kyouma needs.

spans.text: I see... That truly is a power that Hououin Kyouma needs.

units.rawText: However, I was talking about going back to Akihabara. Assistant, I shall give you another chance to answer me!
units.displayText: However, I was talking about going back to Akihabara. Assistant, I shall give you another chance to answer me!

spans.text: However, I was talking about going back to Akihabara. Assistant, I shall give you another chance to answer me!

units.rawText: It feels unreal to hear you ask such a distant question all of a sudden.
units.displayText: It feels unreal to hear you ask such a distant question all of a sudden.

spans.text: It feels unreal to hear you ask such a distant question all of a sudden.

units.rawText: Let me think... I'll probably head back to grab the sewing kit I left in my hotel room.
units.displayText: Let me think... I'll probably head back to grab the sewing kit I left in my hotel room.

spans.text: Let me think... I'll probably head back to grab the sewing kit I left in my hotel room.

units.rawText: (Sigh) We've been fighting for so long that my coat's been ruined...
units.displayText: (Sigh) We've been fighting for so long that my coat's been ruined...

spans.text: (Sigh) We've been fighting for so long that my coat's been ruined...

units.rawText: Well, that was an unexpected answer... Here I thought you'd be eager to go back and crank out a scientific paper...
units.displayText: Well, that was an unexpected answer... Here I thought you'd be eager to go back and crank out a scientific paper...

spans.text: Well, that was an unexpected answer... Here I thought you'd be eager to go back and crank out a scientific paper...

units.rawText: How rude, even I would...
units.displayText: How rude, even I would...

spans.text: How rude, even I would...

units.rawText: The earth shakes, interrupting our conversation.
units.displayText: The earth shakes, interrupting our conversation.

spans.text: The earth shakes, interrupting our conversation.

units.rawText: ...Is it here at last?!
units.displayText: ...Is it here at last?!

spans.text: ...Is it here at last?!

units.rawText: Stick to the plan, Okabe. Is it ready?
units.displayText: Stick to the plan, Okabe. Is it ready?

spans.text: Stick to the plan, Okabe. Is it ready?

units.rawText: Of course!
units.displayText: Of course!

spans.text: Of course!

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Hssss...</color>
units.displayText: Hssss...

spans.text: Hssss...

units.rawText: A low roar comes from the other side of the cafe. In the blink of an eye, the wall that was blocking the entrance is easily crushed to powder by dark purple tentacles.
units.displayText: A low roar comes from the other side of the cafe. In the blink of an eye, the wall that was blocking the entrance is easily crushed to powder by dark purple tentacles.

spans.text: A low roar comes from the other side of the cafe. In the blink of an eye, the wall that was blocking the entrance is easily crushed to powder by dark purple tentacles.

units.rawText: The monster chasing us has turned up, as expected. Its ugly form crawls over the debris, dark purple slime oozing from its body and corroding everything around it.
units.displayText: The monster chasing us has turned up, as expected. Its ugly form crawls over the debris, dark purple slime oozing from its body and corroding everything around it.

spans.text: The monster chasing us has turned up, as expected. Its ugly form crawls over the debris, dark purple slime oozing from its body and corroding everything around it.

units.rawText: The already cramped ruins end up even more confining because of it. The surrounding walls shake and rupture as though they might collapse at any moment.
units.displayText: The already cramped ruins end up even more confining because of it. The surrounding walls shake and rupture as though they might collapse at any moment.

units.displayText: Okabe, now!

spans.text: Okabe, now!

units.rawText: <size=60>—Die!</size>
units.displayText: —Die!

spans.text: —Die!

units.displayText: I throw the object in my hand at the Entropic in front of me.

spans.text: I throw the object in my hand at the Entropic in front of me.

units.rawText: In the blink of an eye, it is easily torn apart by the Entropic's tentacles, spraying white powder throughout the interior of the cramped room.
units.displayText: In the blink of an eye, it is easily torn apart by the Entropic's tentacles, spraying white powder throughout the interior of the cramped room.

spans.text: In the blink of an eye, it is easily torn apart by the Entropic's tentacles, spraying white powder throughout the interior of the cramped room.

units.rawText: Alright! Just as planned!
units.displayText: Alright! Just as planned!

spans.text: Alright! Just as planned!

units.displayText: Unya... But that's in Akihabara... not even I could conjure ingredients out of thin air ~nya.

spans.text: Unya... But that's in Akihabara... not even I could conjure ingredients out of thin air ~nya.

flour
left in the kitchen nya...

sparks
spray out from around our feet every now and then. The air is so foul that it's hard to breathe.

spans.text: (Coughs) Why did you take us to a ruin like this...

units.rawText: ...It's enough to have somewhere safe to hide at a time like this. Don't be picky.
units.displayText: ...It's enough to have somewhere safe to hide at a time like this. Don't be picky.

spans.text: ...It's enough to have somewhere safe to hide at a time like this. Don't be picky.

units.rawText: Fortunately, successfully sending the D-Mail means that the cafe is full of supplies, such as the bag of flour I just threw at that monster.
units.displayText: Fortunately, successfully sending the D-Mail means that the cafe is full of supplies, such as the bag of flour I just threw at that monster.

spans.text: Fortunately, successfully sending the D-Mail means that the cafe is full of supplies, such as the bag of flour I just threw at that monster.

units.rawText: While their owner is nowhere to be found, the things she left behind can be put to good use.
units.displayText: While their owner is nowhere to be found, the things she left behind can be put to good use.

spans.text: While their owner is nowhere to be found, the things she left behind can be put to good use.

units.rawText: Muhahahaha! O purple monster, do you happen to know what a dust explosion is?
units.displayText: Muhahahaha! O purple monster, do you happen to know what a dust explosion is?

spans.text: Muhahahaha! O purple monster, do you happen to know what a dust explosion is?

units.rawText: Well now, this is the perfect time for you to feel the power of science! I call this—
units.displayText: Well now, this is the perfect time for you to feel the power of science! I call this—

spans.text: Well now, this is the perfect time for you to feel the power of science! I call this—

units.rawText: <size=40>Cut the crap and get back here!</size>
units.displayText: Cut the crap and get back here!

spans.text: Cut the crap and get back here!

units.displayText: Before I can finish my delivery, my assistant slams the door in front of us shut and pushes a nearby switch on the wall.

spans.text: Before I can finish my delivery, my assistant slams the door in front of us shut and pushes a nearby switch on the wall.

units.displayText: Everything happens in an instant.

spans.text: Everything happens in an instant.

units.displayText: Hss!

spans.text: Hss!

units.rawText: Boom—
units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.rawText: The explosion is far more intense than I expected.
units.displayText: The explosion is far more intense than I expected.

spans.text: The explosion is far more intense than I expected.

units.rawText: There is no time to think. Driven by survival instincts, Kurisu and I frantically duck behind a pile of boxes. It is only when the shaking and roar of the explosion have faded that we poke our heads out to inspect the aftermath.
units.displayText: There is no time to think. Driven by survival instincts, Kurisu and I frantically duck behind a pile of boxes. It is only when the shaking and roar of the explosion have faded that we poke our heads out to inspect the aftermath.

spans.text: There is no time to think. Driven by survival instincts, Kurisu and I frantically duck behind a pile of boxes. It is only when the shaking and roar of the explosion have faded that we poke our heads out to inspect the aftermath.

units.rawText: As the aftershocks of the blast die down, the air is filled with a nauseating purple smoke.
units.displayText: As the aftershocks of the blast die down, the air is filled with a nauseating purple smoke.

spans.text: As the aftershocks of the blast die down, the air is filled with a nauseating purple smoke.

units.rawText: (Coughs) That blast was more powerful than I expected.
units.displayText: (Coughs) That blast was more powerful than I expected.

spans.text: (Coughs) That blast was more powerful than I expected.

units.rawText: (Coughs) Indeed, I didn't expect it to blow that monster to powder...
units.displayText: (Coughs) Indeed, I didn't expect it to blow that monster to powder...

spans.text: (Coughs) Indeed, I didn't expect it to blow that monster to powder...

units.rawText: Not bad, assistant. I didn't think you were this talented at being a mad scientist.
units.displayText: Not bad, assistant. I didn't think you were this talented at being a mad scientist.

spans.text: Not bad, assistant. I didn't think you were this talented at being a mad scientist.

units.rawText: It, it's not like I could help it! The situation is urgent after all!
units.displayText: It, it's not like I could help it! The situation is urgent after all!

spans.text: It, it's not like I could help it! The situation is urgent after all!

units.rawText: No, well done! I will praise you for your excellent results!
units.displayText: No, well done! I will praise you for your excellent results!

spans.text: No, well done! I will praise you for your excellent results!

units.rawText: Wait a minute. Is it me, or is the amount of this purple dust increasing?
units.displayText: Wait a minute. Is it me, or is the amount of this purple dust increasing?

spans.text: Wait a minute. Is it me, or is the amount of this purple dust increasing?

units.rawText: Now that you mention it, it DOES seem a little weird...
units.displayText: Now that you mention it, it DOES seem a little weird...

spans.text: Now that you mention it, it DOES seem a little weird...

units.displayText: I search for the source of the dust and my gaze lands on a stretch of rubble.

spans.text: I search for the source of the dust and my gaze lands on a stretch of rubble.

units.rawText: What... on earth...
units.displayText: What... on earth...

spans.text: What... on earth...

units.rawText: <size=40>Okabe, look out!</size>
units.displayText: Okabe, look out!

spans.text: Okabe, look out!

units.displayText: The rubble before me glows with purple light, and as I reach out to shield my eyes, an intense explosion suddenly engulfs me.

spans.text: The rubble before me glows with purple light, and as I reach out to shield my eyes, an intense explosion suddenly engulfs me.

units.displayText: My vision goes blurry.

spans.text: My vision goes blurry.

units.rawText: The dark purple shockwave easily destroys everything around it, spraying slime and fragments like shrapnel in all directions.
units.displayText: The dark purple shockwave easily destroys everything around it, spraying slime and fragments like shrapnel in all directions.

spans.text: The dark purple shockwave easily destroys everything around it, spraying slime and fragments like shrapnel in all directions.

units.displayText: The last thing I see before my consciousness fades is Kurisu trying to protect me.

spans.text: The last thing I see before my consciousness fades is Kurisu trying to protect me.

units.displayText: Kaboom!!!

units.displayText: Okarin, Okarin! Please wake up!

spans.text: Okarin, Okarin! Please wake up!

units.rawText: Mayu...ri?
units.displayText: Mayu...ri?

spans.text: Mayu...ri?

units.rawText: (Sob) Okarin! I'm so glad you woke up!
units.displayText: (Sob) Okarin! I'm so glad you woke up!

spans.text: (Sob) Okarin! I'm so glad you woke up!

units.displayText: While I'm conscious now, I can still feel wave after wave of pain spreading out from my forehead.

spans.text: While I'm conscious now, I can still feel wave after wave of pain spreading out from my forehead.

units.displayText: Okarin! Be careful, don't stand up too quickly!

spans.text: Okarin! Be careful, don't stand up too quickly!

units.rawText: ...What...happened just now?
units.displayText: ...What...happened just now?

spans.text: ...What...happened just now?

units.displayText: I look around in a daze.

spans.text: I look around in a daze.

units.displayText: I'm surrounded by rubble, but everything around me is different from what I saw before.

units.displayText: Mayushii doesn't get it...

spans.text: Mayushii doesn't get it...

units.displayText: ...Two explosions...

spans.text: ...Two explosions...

units.rawText: Hng!
units.displayText: Hng!

spans.text: Hng!

units.displayText: ...Kurisu! Where's Kurisu?!

spans.text: ...Kurisu! Where's Kurisu?!

units.rawText: I'm here...
units.displayText: I'm here...

spans.text: I'm here...

units.rawText: Kurisu!
units.displayText: Kurisu!

spans.text: Kurisu!

units.displayText: I rush up to support the girl who's barely able to walk.

units.displayText: ...Okabe, the second explosion was caused by... Urgh!

units.displayText: Kurisu can't continue as a look of pain crosses her face.

units.displayText: This isn't the time for that! You need medical attention right now!

units.rawText: I'm fine, it was just a scratch...
units.displayText: I'm fine, it was just a scratch...

units.displayText: Disheartening growls come from all around us.
